description: This file contains utility methods for testing Orleans streaming components, including logging test start/end, retrieving pub/sub instances, checking pub/sub counts, and asserting equality, specifically tailored for Azure Queue stream provider tests within Orleans.

classes.name: StreamTestUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for logging, pub/sub management, and assertions in Orleans streaming tests.

methods.name: LogStartTest
methods.description: Logs the start of a test, including silo addresses and stream details.

methods.name: LogEndTest
methods.description: Logs the end of a test.

methods.name: GetStreamPubSub
methods.description: Retrieves the pub/sub instance for a given Orleans cluster client.

methods.name: CheckPubSubCounts
methods.description: Checks and asserts the expected number of publishers and consumers for a specific stream.

methods.name: Assert_AreEqual
methods.description: Asserts that two integers are equal, with optional suppression if expected is -1.
